revisionDetection.strategy: Read SMBIOS baseboard vendor/product/version; do not treat an empty or generic SMBIOS Version as a verified PCB revision. Ask for physical confirmation when ambiguous.

1.0.evidence: GIGABYTE feature page explicitly lists Smart Fan 5 for Rev. 1.0.
1.0.fanControlPolicy: Read-only unless a supported sensor/controller interface is detected; manual curve changes require preview and confirmation.

1.1.evidence: GIGABYTE feature page explicitly lists Smart Fan 5 for Rev. 1.1.
1.1.fanControlPolicy: Read-only unless a supported sensor/controller interface is detected; manual curve changes require preview and confirmation.

1.2.evidence: GIGABYTE feature page explicitly lists Smart Fan 6 for Rev. 1.2.
1.2.fanControlPolicy: Read-only unless a supported sensor/controller interface is detected; manual curve changes require preview and confirmation.

memory.note: Do not infer maximum capacity from DIMM count; verify the exact CPU, memory QVL and revision documentation.

storage.m2: M.2 2280, PCIe Gen 3 x4 NVMe; actual support may vary by CPU

network.note: GIGABYTE specification says its bundled LAN bandwidth management software was discontinued following contract termination. Do not offer it as a current supported utility.

hardwareMonitoring.note: Fan speed control depends on the installed cooler and the exact board revision.

officialSoftware.purpose: Portal para encontrar utilitários e drivers publicados pela GIGABYTE.
officialSoftware.policy: List the portal only when the exact revision/OS support page offers it. APP Center applications and their functions vary by board model.

officialSoftware.purpose: Utility described by GIGABYTE for system and memory clock/voltage tuning.
officialSoftware.policy: Never apply automatic overclock, clock or voltage changes. Only show as an optional vendor utility after exact compatibility verification.

officialSoftware.purpose: Windows utility described by GIGABYTE for BIOS update and backup.
officialSoftware.policy: Reference only; do not perform unattended firmware updates.

officialSoftware.purpose: Utility named in the board's GIGABYTE unique-features list.
officialSoftware.policy: Verify that the download is currently offered for the detected revision and OS.

officialSoftware.purpose: Monitor clocks, processor, fan profiles and temperature alerts as described by GIGABYTE.
officialSoftware.policy: Optional. Prefer read-only monitoring and avoid competing with other fan-control services.
Manual guided workflow only; exact revision and BIOS file must be verified; never flash automatically.

driverSources.policy: Treat this as a review-time observation, not a permanent latest-version constant. Query AMD dynamically before presenting any update.
Match the detected Realtek hardware ID and Windows edition. Check the support page for the selected PCB revision and keep a rollback path.
Match the detected audio device ID and Windows edition. Do not remove audio services or enhancements blindly.

biosObservation.note: Observation only for Rev. 1.0. The application must recheck the correct revision page. Newer does not automatically mean recommended for every CPU or system.

ynoezRecommendations.name: Identificação da placa
ynoezRecommendations.description: Detect manufacturer, model, SMBIOS version, BIOS, CPU, memory and PnP IDs. Ask the user to confirm physical PCB revision when SMBIOS is ambiguous.

ynoezRecommendations.name: Verificar driver do chipset
ynoezRecommendations.description: Compare the installed package with AMD's current official A520 page and show release notes before installation.

ynoezRecommendations.name: Diagnóstico da rede cabeada
ynoezRecommendations.description: Identify controller and driver, negotiated link speed, errors, disconnects, latency, jitter and packet loss. Compare before/after any proposed change.

ynoezRecommendations.name: Energia do adaptador de rede
ynoezRecommendations.description: Inspect NIC energy properties and offer reversible changes only when evidence points to power saving as a cause of instability.

ynoezRecommendations.name: Monitoramento térmico e de ventoinhas
ynoezRecommendations.description: Show real sensors and RPMs only through a supported interface. Do not fabricate readings or run two competing fan controllers.

ynoezRecommendations.name: Verificação de XMP
ynoezRecommendations.description: Detect modules and current configured memory speed; provide manual XMP guidance only after compatibility and stability checks.

ynoezRecommendations.name: Verificação de BIOS
ynoezRecommendations.description: Read the installed firmware version and open the correct revision's official page. Update remains manual and requires exact-file verification.
